description.p: Glyphvane is a fast, native Markdown editor for notes that link to each other. Open a single file or a whole folder of notes, write with Live Preview, and follow links across everything you have written.

ul.li: Live Preview hides Markdown markup away from the cursor and shows images, math, tables, code and diagrams right where you type
Reading, Source and Split views, with scrolling kept in step
Wikilinks, heading links and block references that work across the whole folder, with hover previews and backlinks
Renaming or moving a note updates every link to it
Renders CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown and Obsidian notes the way each defines them, with callouts, footnotes, math and Mermaid diagrams
Search with a query language, tags, bookmarks, an outline, a quick switcher and a command palette
Exports to HTML and PDF, and prints
Autosave, crash recovery and version history keep your writing safe

description.p: Glyphvane is free software and works offline. It sends no telemetry and needs no account.
Why it asks for these permissions:

ul.li: Home folder: to follow links and show images in notes anywhere in your home folder, and to update links in other notes when you rename or move one
Network: only to load images and media a note links from the web, after you allow them
Sound: to play audio embedded in notes; it never records
Graphics card and display: to draw its windows smoothly

screenshot.caption: A note in the Reading view, with a table, highlighted code, math and a Mermaid diagram
Live Preview: markup hides away from the cursor, and images, math, tables and code render in place
Source and preview side by side, scrolling together
Work with a folder of notes: files, outline, backlinks and link previews
Render each document as CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown, Obsidian or Extended
Search the whole folder with a query language
Open Obsidian canvases with cards, groups, edges and a minimap
Bases show notes as tables, grouped and computed from their properties
Export to HTML or PDF with page options and a live preview
Recover unsaved work after a crash and merge it with the file on disk
Every command is in the palette, in light or dark

description.p: A built-in PDF viewer with find, text selection and copying, which reopens where you left off.
Richer note embeds, typeset math in search results and backlinks, emoji in the Reading view, and highlighted code and diagrams in canvas cards.
Better screen reader support in the editor, and many fixes.

Live Preview: an Edit-mode style that hides Markdown markers away from the cursor and draws images, math, task checkboxes, tags, code blocks, tables, diagrams, callouts and embeds in place. A zoom menu in the status bar, more zoom keys, and the zoom level kept between launches.

The first stable release. Glyphvane reads and edits Markdown files and folders of notes, with a Reading view, a Source view and a Split view, link navigation and link checking across the folder, vault search, HTML and PDF export, printing, and read-only Canvas and Bases views. Builds for Linux, macOS and Windows are on GitHub Releases.
